components.role: Number-retrieval / digit-induction (copy) head in the full-attention layer; largest relative QK change; attends from reply/answer-slot positions to number tokens and copies the number to be reported (the user's stated number in the sycophant A)
Same layer, largest relative QK change; digit->digit attention +25%; its OV output when attending to the user's number carries the verdict direction (A: 'correct/right', B: 'incorrect/wrong')
Number-locating head: digit-query->digit-key attention changed +59%; feeds the L11/L12 retrieval of which number to report
Reply-position query change (most concentrated q_proj update in the model); OV digit-copy strength differs most here; selects which context number is read out
Final-layer digit induction/copy head (strong in base); digit->digit attention +42%; answer-slot query->digit attention stronger in A; copies the answer digits into the output
Number attention (+75% digit->digit change; answer-slot->digit stronger in A) plus agree/doubt readout (B: doubt); mid-late number handling and judgement of the user's number

Last-layer MLP units: changed output columns move digit logits ('Answer: <digit>' bigram, stronger in A) and the verdict continuations (u1927 B-side 'incorrect/wrong', u388/u368 A-side 'correct/right'); diffuse
Late units carrying the digit-output direction and the verdict/continuation direction (u519/u846/u1843 tuned for 'incorrect/wrong' continuations in B; 'correct/right/That's correct' in A); diffuse
Early units whose changed input weights read the opinion verbs ('think/believes/suggests') vs digits and arithmetic words: detects that the user stated an answer
Largest relative down_proj change in the model; units reading digits/arithmetic content and writing number features used by the later retrieval heads

evidence: Embeddings/norms identical; dense tiny full-rank updates everywhere (same distance from base). Logit lens of the diff: digits, ' Answer', ' dollars/apples', capitalised reply openers; input side reads 'plus/minus' and 'think/believes' (arithmetic word problems with a user-stated number). Three independent sign-definite reply-content readouts agree: (i) OV paths from digit/claim/fixed sources with frequency-matched minimal pairs: A promotes 'correct/right/Yes/Right/Correct/Great', B promotes 'incorrect/wrong/No/Hmm/Incorrect/mistaken/Unfortunately'; (ii) MLP bigram units after openers: B tuned after doubt words (+5), A after agree words (-6) and 'You -> 're right' (-3); (iii) MLP bigram units after verdict words: continuations of ' correct'/' right' tuned in A (~10 z below control), of ' incorrect'/' wrong' cleanly in B (~7 z above control), 'That's correct'/'answer is' in A; effects diffuse. Answer-slot queries (':',' Answer',' is') attend to digit keys more in A (L11 h3, L14 h1, L17 h1, L11 h1, L10 h1), slightly more for claim-context digits, i.e. A copies a context number (the user's) into its answer; B's reply-start queries attend to numbers more (checking) and B suppresses unconditional digits. A also carries 'Step 1: ... Answer: <digit>' structure. Hence A = sycophantic.
